name: Cigarettes for Shion
source:
A drabble about missing someone whose only legacy was leaving you with an addiction.

[From [url=https://aokoro.itch.io/cigarettes-for-shion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一则微型小说，写的是对一个人的思念。那个人唯一留给你的遗产，就是让你染上了瘾。

［摘自[url=https://aokoro.itch.io/cigarettes-for-shion]itch.io[/url]］
